name: Gaussian Rasterization Key Generation
definition: Generates key-value pairs for all Gaussian-tile overlaps to enable sorting by tile ID and depth. Each Gaussian generates one key-value pair per tile it overlaps.
summary: Gaussian Rasterization Key Generation creates 64-bit sort keys combining tile ID and depth for all Gaussian-tile overlaps, distinguishing itself by explicitly generating full overlap sets for sorting rather than filtering.
